qualification_rule: Count only actual issuer equity or equity-linked dilution occurring from T-90 through T+30. Theoretical shelf or ATM registration capacity without actual issuance is not sufficient.

rows.evidence_summary: Bulk SEC EDGAR submissions sweep for CIK 1597264 (Blueprint Medicines Corporation) found zero 424B1/424B2/424B3/424B4/424B5, S-1, S-1/A, S-3, or S-3/A filings, and zero 8-K filings with Item 3.02, dated between 2020-01-28 and 2020-05-28 (T-90 through T+30). Coverage confirmed: the issuer's 'recent' EDGAR filings array reaches back to 2015-04-30, well before the window. No registered or PIPE equity issuance is evidenced in the financing window.
